name: mapi
description: A memory API for AI agents: hybrid retrieval, belief revision, and a graph of what the system believes and why.

MAPI_API_KEY_PEPPER.description: Secret used to hash API keys. Rotating it invalidates every existing key.

MAPI_SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs the browser session cookie for the dashboard.

MAPI_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth client id from Google Cloud console.

MAPI_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth client secret. Set with `heroku config:set`, never committed.

MAPI_GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google AI Studio key. Used instead of Vertex+ADC because a dyno has no gcloud credentials; the provider takes either.
